title: Slots endpoint returns the available departments for a lab
precondition: Lab 42 exists with one radiology department and capacity 1.
steps:
1. Send GET /radiology/v1/slots?lab_id=42
2. Assert status == 200
3. Assert body.slots.0.departments is present
4. Assert body.slots.0.remaining_capacity == 1
expected: The response lists one department with remaining_capacity 1.
qa_comment: Covers REQ-1. Routes copied verbatim from the contract.

title: Slots endpoint rejects an unknown lab id
steps:
1. Send GET /radiology/v1/slots?lab_id=999999
2. Assert status == 404
3. Assert body.error == "lab_not_found"
expected: The service answers 404 with error lab_not_found and no slots array.
qa_comment: Covers REQ-2, error contract table row 1.

title: Slot picker keeps its selection when the network drops mid-fetch
precondition: A slot is already selected on https://app.test/radiology/slots.
steps:
1. Navigate to https://app.test/radiology/slots
2. Select the 11:00 slot
3. Disable the network in devtools
4. Tap Continue
5. Assert the inline error reads exactly "Check your connection and try again"
expected: The selection survives the failed request and the inline error names the connection.

title: Capacity endpoint decrements after a booking
precondition: Lab 42 has capacity 2 and one booking already exists.
steps:
1. Send GET /radiology/v1/capacity?lab_id=42
2. Assert status == 200
3. Assert body.remaining == 1
expected: remaining is 1, one below the seeded capacity.

title: Overbooking is rejected at the database constraint
steps:
1. Attempt a second booking through the admin console for lab 42
2. Inspect the bookings table for lab 42
3. Assert exactly one row exists
expected: The insert is refused and the table still holds exactly one booking row.
qa_comment: Covers REQ-5. Manual: the assertion is on DB state, not a response.

title: Two concurrent bookings race for the last slot on Android
precondition: Lab 42 has exactly one slot left; two devices are signed in as different users.
steps:
1. Launch the app and open the deep link diagno://radiology/slots?lab_id=42 on both devices
2. Tap Book on both within one second
3. Assert exactly one device shows the confirmation screen
4. Assert the other shows "That slot was just taken"
expected: One booking succeeds and the loser sees the slot-taken message, with no double booking.
